$comment: Generated by api/tools/gen_reason_codes.py; do not edit by hand. CP-2 reason-code registry.

fields.detail: embedded in another entry's field (e.g. FE-REC-002 'artefact rejected: {detail}')

rules: Codes are stable (never reused or renumbered). Since 2026-10-17 the engine adds the code as `reasonCode` next to every reported reason (status records and device events). A text matches the entry whose pattern fullmatches it; when several do, the most specific one (most literal characters) wins (flexengine2.contracts.reason_code).

codes.template: desired state with bad/missing cloud signature ignored
codes.pattern: ^desired\ state\ with\ bad/missing\ cloud\ signature\ ignored$
codes.meaning: X-Flex-Manifest-Signature / desired.sig does not verify with cloudPublicKey

codes.template: desired state for another device ignored
codes.meaning: DesiredState.deviceId differs from this engine's deviceId

codes.template: manifestVersion {mv} <= accepted {accepted}: rollback attack? ignored
codes.meaning: lower manifestVersion, or equal with a different body (counted in state.downgradesRefused)

codes.template: desired state is not valid JSON: {error}
codes.meaning: the signed body does not parse as JSON

codes.template: desired state does not match the CP-1 schema: {errors}
codes.pattern: ^desired\ state\ does\ not\ match\ the\ CP\-1\ schema:\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: the signed document fails desired-state.v1alpha1 (first three violations, '; '-joined)

codes.template: desired state has invalid deployment dependencies: {errors}
codes.meaning: x-flex-dependsOn (EV-42) names a deployment absent from the document, itself or one twice, or the dependencies form a cycle; refused as a whole, the previous state keeps running (first three violations, '; '-joined)

codes.template: cloud key at onboarding does not match the provisioned trust anchor
codes.pattern: ^cloud\ key\ at\ onboarding\ does\ not\ match\ the\ provisioned\ trust\ anchor$
codes.meaning: onboarding response cloudPublicKey differs from cfg cloudPublicKey; the device stays un-onboarded

codes.template: bundle without desired state
codes.meaning: offline bundle lacks desired.json or desired.sig

codes.template: bundle desired state is not signed by the cloud key
codes.pattern: ^bundle\ desired\ state\ is\ not\ signed\ by\ the\ cloud\ key$
codes.meaning: the bundle's desired.sig does not verify with cloudPublicKey; nothing from the bundle is stored

codes.template: local API socket path is {bytes} bytes, longer than the {max} this platform allows: {path} (set local.socket to a shorter path)
codes.pattern: ^local\ API\ socket\ path\ is\ (.+?)\ bytes,\ longer\ than\ the\ (.+?)\ this\ platform\ allows:\ (.+?)\ \(set\ local\.socket\ to\ a\ shorter\ path\)$
codes.meaning: the Unix socket path (local.socket, default <dataDir>/api.sock without /run/flexengine) does not fit sun_path: 107 bytes on Linux, 103 on macOS; config check flags an explicit local.socket

codes.template: {path}: another engine already serves the local API
codes.pattern: ^(.+?):\ another\ engine\ already\ serves\ the\ local\ API$
codes.meaning: a live engine answers on the configured socket; this one does not take it over

codes.template: local.tcp needs tokenFile
codes.meaning: the read-only TCP bind is configured without a bearer token file (the config schema refuses it first)

codes.template: no driver for {profile}
codes.meaning: x-flex-driver names a profile with no driver on this device; manifest version rejected

codes.template: artefact rejected: {detail}
codes.meaning: release verification or driver preflight refused the artefact; the whole manifest version is rejected and the previous state keeps running (detail = an FE-ART/-CLD/-*-PRE code)

codes.template: apply failed
codes.meaning: driver apply raised DriverError; rolled back (detail in failure, FE-REC-005)

codes.template: health check failed
codes.meaning: health gate failed; rolled back (detail in failure: FE-HG-*, or the driver's failed() text)

codes.template: apply failed: {error}
codes.meaning: the DriverError text of the failed apply (an FE-CTR/-NAT/-SYD/-APL/-MCU/-PLC/-RAU code)

codes.template: drift repaired (workload was missing)
codes.meaning: a committed workload disappeared and was re-created

codes.template: supervisor: {event}
codes.meaning: local supervision event: restarted (state Installed) or start-limit-hit (state Failed)

codes.template: drift repaired (executor ran another release)
codes.meaning: supervise(): a committed workload's executor ran another digest than the committed one (drift by digest); the committed release was re-applied (EV-13)

codes.template: interrupted install of {version} abandoned (no longer desired)
codes.meaning: restart after a crash during an install the accepted desired state no longer asks for: the uncommitted release was taken off the executor -- the committed version restored (state Installed) or the deployment removed (state Removed) (EV-13)

codes.template: interrupted install of {version} held: waiting for {deployments}
codes.meaning: restart after a crash during an install the desired state still asks for, but a dependency (x-flex-dependsOn) is not ready: the uncommitted release was taken off the executor (committed version restored, state Installed, or deployment removed, state Removed) and is installed again once the dependency is ready (EV-42)

codes.template: awaiting safe state: {signals}
codes.meaning: required safe-state signals are not true (FE-S6; implicit machine_parked, operator_confirmed for safety-relevant)

codes.template: outside activation window {start}-{end} UTC
codes.meaning: x-flex-activation.window is closed

codes.template: held: PLC not verified: {requires}
codes.meaning: plc:<dep>[@hash] requirement not yet verified by plc-verify

codes.template: held: waiting for {deployments}
codes.meaning: x-flex-dependsOn (EV-42): a dependency does not run its desired release yet (or is not healthy, condition healthy); the install/update waits on its previous version, re-checked every tick

codes.template: held: waiting for removal of {deployments}
codes.meaning: x-flex-dependsOn (EV-42), operation remove: dependents of this deployment are still being removed (removals run in reverse dependency order)

codes.template: timeout after {timeoutSeconds} s
codes.meaning: no successThreshold consecutive healthy probes within timeoutSeconds

codes.template: commit failed: {error}
codes.meaning: two-phase driver commit raised DriverError after a passed gate

codes.template: {status}: {body}
codes.meaning: definite 4xx from flexCloud while fetching an artefact (cloud.client.Rejected)

codes.meaning: driver config lacks sharedDataPath; every os-rauc deployment is refused

codes.template: engine data dir {dataDir} is not on the shared data partition {sharedDataPath} (sharedDataPath): manifestVersion and the outbox would not survive the slot switch
codes.pattern: ^engine\ data\ dir\ (.+?)\ is\ not\ on\ the\ shared\ data\ partition\ (.+?)\ \(sharedDataPath\):\ manifestVersion\ and\ the\ outbox\ would\ not\ survive\ the\ slot\ switch$
codes.meaning: the engine's data dir is not under sharedDataPath (plan section 3.5)

codes.template: os-rauc payload lacks the dev.flex.compatible annotation
codes.meaning: bundle layer without its RAUC compatible annotation

codes.template: bundle is for compatible {compatible}, this device is {device}
codes.pattern: ^bundle\ is\ for\ compatible\ (.+?),\ this\ device\ is\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: dev.flex.compatible differs from `rauc status` compatible

codes.template: rauc info refused the bundle: {error}
codes.meaning: `rauc info` (with the device keyring) failed: bad CMS signature, untrusted signer, not a bundle

codes.template: rauc info refused the bundle: unreadable output ({error})
codes.pattern: ^rauc\ info\ refused\ the\ bundle:\ unreadable\ output\ \((.+?)\)$
codes.meaning: `rauc info --output-format=json` printed no JSON

codes.template: bundle manifest says compatible {bundle}, its annotation says {annotation}
codes.pattern: ^bundle\ manifest\ says\ compatible\ (.+?),\ its\ annotation\ says\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: the signed bundle's manifest and the release's layer annotation disagree

codes.template: os-rauc: cannot execute {binary} (not found: {error})
codes.meaning: rauc (or the reboot command) is not installed; capabilities() reports available: false

codes.template: os-rauc: cannot execute {binary} ({error})
codes.meaning: rauc (or the reboot command) is not executable

codes.template: os-rauc: {cmd} gave no answer within {timeout} s
codes.meaning: rauc call hung (cliTimeout / installTimeoutSeconds): executor unreachable

codes.template: os-rauc: {cmd} failed: {error} (exit {rc})
codes.meaning: rauc call (status, install, mark-*) or the reboot command failed; status/D-Bus failures make the executor unreachable

codes.template: rauc status: unreadable output ({error})
codes.meaning: `rauc status --output-format=json` printed no JSON

codes.template: one OS image per device: deployment {dep} already owns the OS
codes.pattern: ^one\ OS\ image\ per\ device:\ deployment\ (.+?)\ already\ owns\ the\ OS$
codes.meaning: exclusive executor already used by another deployment

codes.template: rauc install did not activate another slot (primary {primary}, booted {booted})
codes.pattern: ^rauc\ install\ did\ not\ activate\ another\ slot\ \(primary\ (.+?),\ booted\ (.+?)\)$
codes.meaning: after a successful install the boot primary is not the other slot

codes.template: reboot request failed: {error}
codes.meaning: rebootCommand failed; the booted slot is made primary again

codes.template: no reboot within {seconds} s after the request ({cmd}); slot {slot} stays active
codes.pattern: ^no\ reboot\ within\ (.+?)\ s\ after\ the\ request\ \((.+?)\);\ slot\ (.+?)\ stays\ active$
codes.meaning: the reboot did not end the engine within bootTimeoutSeconds; the booted slot is made primary again

codes.template: bootloader fell back to slot {slot}: {version} in slot {target} did not boot or was not committed
codes.pattern: ^bootloader\ fell\ back\ to\ slot\ (.+?):\ (.+?)\ in\ slot\ (.+?)\ did\ not\ boot\ or\ was\ not\ committed$
codes.meaning: fail fast: the boot after the install went to the old slot (image did not come up, boot counter exhausted); also failed() during the gate

codes.template: {version} was rolled back: rebooted from slot {from} into slot {to} ({previous}) after its health gate failed
codes.pattern: ^(.+?)\ was\ rolled\ back:\ rebooted\ from\ slot\ (.+?)\ into\ slot\ (.+?)\ \((.+?)\)\ after\ its\ health\ gate\ failed$
codes.meaning: re-apply of a digest the driver rolled back while the engine was down (reported once)

codes.template: {version} was removed before it was committed: rebooted from slot {from} into slot {to}
codes.pattern: ^(.+?)\ was\ removed\ before\ it\ was\ committed:\ rebooted\ from\ slot\ (.+?)\ into\ slot\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: re-apply of a never committed image that remove() rolled back (reported once)

codes.template: booted slot {slot} is marked bad
codes.meaning: fail fast: the target slot is booted but RAUC reports boot status bad

codes.template: booted slot {slot} is not the target slot {target}: not marking it good
codes.pattern: ^booted\ slot\ (.+?)\ is\ not\ the\ target\ slot\ (.+?):\ not\ marking\ it\ good$
codes.meaning: commit (rauc status mark-good) refused: the device did not boot the target slot

codes.template: board {board} is not configured on {device} (arduino-ota boards: {known})
codes.meaning: the deployment's parameter board (or, with one board configured, the default) names no configured board

codes.template: arduino-ota payload lacks the dev.flex.board annotation
codes.meaning: firmware layer without its board FQBN

codes.template: firmware is for {fqbn}, board {board} is {boardFqbn}
codes.meaning: dev.flex.board differs from the target board's FQBN

codes.template: arduino-ota payload lacks the dev.flex.firmwareVersion annotation
codes.meaning: firmware layer without the version its sketch reports

codes.template: not a usable OTA image: {error}
codes.meaning: the .ota header check failed (FE-AOTA-IMG-*), or the file is unreadable

codes.template: not an OTA image: {size} bytes
codes.meaning: shorter than the 20-byte Arduino_Portenta_OTA header

codes.template: not an OTA image: header length {length}, file has {size} bytes after it
codes.pattern: ^not\ an\ OTA\ image:\ header\ length\ (.+?),\ file\ has\ (.+?)\ bytes\ after\ it$
codes.meaning: header length field does not match the file

codes.template: OTA image CRC-32 mismatch (corrupt image)
codes.meaning: header CRC-32 does not match the image body

codes.template: no OTA support known for board {fqbn}
codes.meaning: no .ota board magic known for the FQBN

codes.template: OTA image is for {imageBoard}, the board is {fqbn}
codes.pattern: ^OTA\ image\ is\ for\ (.+?),\ the\ board\ is\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: the header's board magic belongs to another board

codes.template: command key in {path} is {n} bytes (at least 16 expected)
codes.pattern: ^command\ key\ in\ (.+?)\ is\ (.+?)\ bytes\ \(at\ least\ 16\ expected\)$
codes.meaning: commandKeyFile too short (embedded in FE-AOTA-003)

codes.template: arduino-ota: cannot read {path} ({error})
codes.meaning: an MQTT/Redis passwordFile is unreadable

codes.template: arduino-ota: board {board} has no commandKeyFile
codes.meaning: board config without the node key (refused at preflight)

codes.template: arduino-ota: board {board}: unusable command key file {path} ({error})
codes.meaning: commandKeyFile unreadable or not a key (refused at preflight)

codes.template: arduino-ota: no board {board} on {device} (configured: {known})
codes.meaning: apply of a deployment whose board is not configured

codes.template: arduino-ota: serve needs certFile + keyFile (https) or allowPlainHttp: true (the image's sha256 travels in the signed command, the transfer itself is then unencrypted)
codes.pattern: ^arduino\-ota:\ serve\ needs\ certFile\ \+\ keyFile\ \(https\)\ or\ allowPlainHttp:\ true\ \(the\ image's\ sha256\ travels\ in\ the\ signed\ command,\ the\ transfer\ itself\ is\ then\ unencrypted\)$
codes.meaning: image server config: neither TLS nor the plain-http lab flag (DA-4)

codes.template: arduino-ota: serve.publicUrl is needed when serving on all interfaces (the URL the boards download from)
codes.pattern: ^arduino\-ota:\ serve\.publicUrl\ is\ needed\ when\ serving\ on\ all\ interfaces\ \(the\ URL\ the\ boards\ download\ from\)$
codes.meaning: serve.host is 0.0.0.0 and no publicUrl

codes.template: arduino-ota: cannot serve images on {host}:{port} ({error})
codes.meaning: the image server cannot bind (port in use) or load its TLS key

codes.template: arduino-ota: cannot send the OTA command to {node}: {error}
codes.pattern: ^arduino\-ota:\ cannot\ send\ the\ OTA\ command\ to\ (.+?):\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: MQTT broker unreachable or refused the client / the publish

codes.template: one firmware per board: deployment {dep} already owns board {board}
codes.pattern: ^one\ firmware\ per\ board:\ deployment\ (.+?)\ already\ owns\ board\ (.+?)$
codes.meaning: exclusive executor: the board already runs another deployment

codes.template: arduino-ota: flexCloud Redis of board {board} unreachable: {error}
codes.meaning: executor unreachable: the node's keys cannot be read

codes.template: board {board} ({node}) is offline: no heartbeat key
codes.meaning: the node writes no heartbeat (powered off, network down, or a library without the patch); nothing is sent

codes.template: no answer from {node} within {seconds} s after the OTA command (last state {state}): the board did not come back
codes.pattern: ^no\ answer\ from\ (.+?)\ within\ (.+?)\ s\ after\ the\ OTA\ command\ \(last\ state\ (.+?)\):\ the\ board\ did\ not\ come\ back$
codes.meaning: fail fast: updateTimeoutSeconds passed (download hung, or the new firmware never booted)

codes.template: {node} did not accept the OTA command within {seconds} s (node offline, wrong command key, or a flexNode-arduino without the remote OTA command)
codes.pattern: ^(.+?)\ did\ not\ accept\ the\ OTA\ command\ within\ (.+?)\ s\ \(node\ offline,\ wrong\ command\ key,\ or\ a\ flexNode\-arduino\ without\ the\ remote\ OTA\ command\)$
codes.meaning: the node's ota key never named the command id (acceptTimeoutSeconds)

codes.template: {node} rejected the OTA command: {reason}
codes.meaning: the node answered rejected (wrong board, OTA disabled, update in progress, expired)

codes.template: OTA failed on {node}, it keeps firmware {version}: {reason}
codes.meaning: fail fast: download / size / sha256 / decompress / install failed on the node; it runs the old firmware (Arduino_Portenta_OTA falls back)

codes.template: {node} restarted into firmware {running}, not {version}: the bootloader did not install the image
codes.pattern: ^(.+?)\ restarted\ into\ firmware\ (.+?),\ not\ (.+?):\ the\ bootloader\ did\ not\ install\ the\ image$
codes.meaning: fail fast: the node came back with another firmware

codes.template: OTA failed on {node}: {reason}
codes.meaning: fail fast during the gate (adopted update): the node reported the update failed or rejected

codes.template: {node} restarted into firmware {running}, not {version}
codes.meaning: fail fast during the gate (adopted update): the node came back with another firmware

codes.template: {node} reports status {status} on firmware {version}
codes.meaning: fail fast: the new firmware booted but reports a failedStatus (default ERROR); the engine re-serves the previous release

codes.template: not a PLC verify artefact (flex-plc.json): {error}
PLC {target} is not configured on {device} (known: {known})
verify spec hash {spec} differs from the release descriptor {descriptor}
codes.pattern: ^verify\ spec\ hash\ (.+?)\ differs\ from\ the\ release\ descriptor\ (.+?)$

codes.template: payload annotation dev.flex.ifaceHash differs from the release descriptor
codes.pattern: ^payload\ annotation\ dev\.flex\.ifaceHash\ differs\ from\ the\ release\ descriptor$

codes.template: interface hash mismatch: deployment expects {expect}…, release has {descriptor}…
codes.pattern: ^interface\ hash\ mismatch:\ deployment\ expects\ (.+?)…,\ release\ has\ (.+?)…$
codes.meaning: parameters._interfaceHash differs

codes.template: this engine never downloads PLC programs (decision 2026-10-16): release must say download: false
codes.pattern: ^this\ engine\ never\ downloads\ PLC\ programs\ \(decision\ 2026\-10\-16\):\ release\ must\ say\ download:\ false$

codes.template: PLC {target} is not configured on {device}
unknown verify transport {via}
{target} runs interface {running}…, the release expects {expect}… ({detail}): program not provisioned for this release
codes.pattern: ^(.+?)\ runs\ interface\ (.+?)…,\ the\ release\ expects\ (.+?)…\ \((.+?)\):\ program\ not\ provisioned\ for\ this\ release$
codes.meaning: fail-fast: the PLC answers with another hash
